conditions.crosscat: Other categories within each other source language; equal language weights

scope: TBR on English and Chinese, four categories and four models; 100 identical prompts in each three-condition cell.
reproduction_scope: Recompute statistics and audit exact evaluator requests/responses from saved outputs. Source vector tensors and generation backend are not included.

generation.norm_calibration: Reuse full 500-prompt mean/std from corresponding cached OMean CSV.
generation.seed_note: New cell seeds recorded below; cached generation seeds were not recorded and are not matched.

models.sampling: First 100 cached test prompts, before new judgments; same prompts in all conditions.
models.control_formula: normalize(sum_s mean_{k in available retained categories excluding target} v[s,k])
models.normalization: Stored normalized vectors (including their bfloat16 rounding), converted to float32; final sum L2-normalized, as in cached OMean. Each source language has equal total weight.

judge.retry_policy: Initial request plus at most three retries per pending job per invocation; reruns retry only unresolved jobs and retain every previous attempt.
